snippet.title: KindFolx PC Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Adventures, it's time! Go forth and release KindFolx from the clutches of Darlocke's tyranny!

Play as 1 of 3 adventurers in this real-time action deckbuilder, each with over 80 unique cards and abilities, in order to liberate the humans and bring peace back to the city!

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408730/KindFolx/
